Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. In particular, fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images and not as text, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when, but not what it shows. Raymundo Solis's fire extinguisher note is the one case today where a technician wrote down what the picture showed.

One further note on timing: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central on 10/08/2026, so no search of the following morning was possible. Submissions for Thursday that arrive overnight or on Friday morning are not included here, and any of the absences listed above could still be a late arrival rather than a missing form.
80 of 80 submissions read. The job board for 10/08/2026 was available and was the board used; 45 manned rows were checked for coverage, 9 on the ArkLaTex board and 36 on the Permian Basin board.
